content: Lenacapavir, a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor, can significantly increase the levels or effects of various drugs by altering hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction may elevate the risk of adverse reactions associated with these drugs. Close monitoring is recommended when co-administering lenacapavir with CYP3A4 substrates, especially those initiated within nine months after the last subcutaneous dose of lenacapavir. Specific examples include: 1. Fluticasone Furoate: Lenacapavir may increase its levels, necessitating caution and monitoring. 2.
